answer: Anchor every agent's identity to a non-refundable bonded stake that is slashed on misbehavior. Picture each honest agent gripping one marble of locked collateral: a sybil swarm must buy a fresh marble per fake identity, so forging a thousand agents means posting a thousand stakes up front. Reputation accrues to the anchor stake itself, never the throwaway wallet, and brand-new identities begin at violet-tier zero trust. Cheap duplicates stay economically worthless.
